content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: BIOC(EDR-001 Shadow File Read by Non-Root Service Account) OR BIOC(EDR-001 Broad Credential File Sweep Across Home Directories) OR BIOC(EDR-001 Process Memory Scrape via proc environ) OR BIOC(EDR-001 Mimipenguin Credential Dumper Execution)
rules.name: Linux Credential Harvesting Chain — passwd/shadow + key sweep + Mimipenguin
